0.0: I have a new request if you're interested...

yes.0: Okay. #b#p1052001##k is at work on a project to replace the worn out bricks in Kerning City. Many #b#t04032802#s#k are required for the project, but they're so hard to obtain.
yes.1: We need #b10 #t04032802#s#k. #bJM#k can make these bricks with #b100 #t4000623#s#k, so go see him first. Once the bricks are made, take them to #b#p1052001##k.

no.0: Are you sure you don't care? The reward is quite significant. Well, come see me again if you change your mind.

npc.0: Take the Mud Clumps to JM.

item.0: There aren't enough Mud Clumps to make the bricks... I need 100 to make 10 bricks.
